[b][size=3]
A simple Fashion Sense mod that gives the farmer cuter shoe options! You'll need the fashion sense mod installed and just go to the slide that says shoes and your ready to go!
[b][size=3]
As of 05/17/24 there are Seven  types: Flatforms, Flats, Flats ver2, High Heels, Heel Boots, Slides, and Two Tone High Heels( you can change both base color and heel color).
[/size][/b]All options are color customizable and are set to skin tone match!
This is based off of the FS templates provided.

[/size][/b]Have an idea or bug report? Please message me! My skills and time are limited  but ill do my best to fix any issues or implement ideas if i'm capable! :-)
